issue.title: Bug: `generic_config_updater/test_bgp_prefix.py` fails due to `Failed to remove bgp prefix v4 config`

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

`generic_config_updater/test_bgp_prefix.py` is failing with:
```
            bgp_config = show_bgp_running_config(duthost, cli_namespace_prefix)
>           pytest_assert(
                not re.search(PREFIXES_V4_RE.format(community, PREFIXES_V4_DUMMY), bgp_config),
                "Failed to remove bgp prefix v4 config."
            )
E           Failed: Failed to remove bgp prefix v4 config.
```

We can see this entry isn't expected to be in the `show runningconfiguration bgp` output:
```
(Pdb) PREFIXES_V4_RE.format(community, PREFIXES_V4_DUMMY)
'ip prefix-list PL_ALLOW_LIST_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0_COMMUNITY_empty_V4 seq \\d+ permit <IP>/16'

(Pdb) re.search(PREFIXES_V4_RE.format(community, PREFIXES_V4_DUMMY), bgp_config)
<re.Match object; span=(435, 525), match='ip prefix-list PL_ALLOW_LIST_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0_COMM>
```

When looking at the syslog after the fact I can see that the prefixes were cleaned up after we polled the bgp running config.
```
2026 Feb  3 <IPV6>.282710 ctn101 NOTICE config: 'apply-patch' executed successfully for localhost by [{'op': 'remove', 'path': '/BGP_ALLOWED_PREFIXES'}] in thread:140060083802368

2026 Feb  3 <IPV6>.630292 ctn101 INFO python[3633817]: ansible-ansible.legacy.command Invoked with _raw_params=show runningconfiguration bgp

2026 Feb  3 <IPV6>.735983 ctn101 DEBUG bgp#bgpcfgd: BGPAllowListMgr::__remove_prefix_lists. af='v4' pl_names='PL_ALLOW_LIST_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0_COMMUNITY_empty_V4'
```

So after I hit the pdb if I re-query the `show runningconfiguration bgp` it will now be correctly excluding those config lines:
```
(Pdb) bgp_config2 = show_bgp_running_config(duthost, cli_namespace_prefix)
Wednesday 04 February 2026  <IPV6> +0000 (<IPV6>.589)       <IPV6>.376 ****
(Pdb) re.search(PREFIXES_V4_RE.format(community, PREFIXES_V4_DUMMY), bgp_config2)
(Pdb)
```

I've seen other places in this file that converted an `assert` to a `wait_until`.
E.G. https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/19521

I think this will be another place where we should use a `wait_until`.

### Steps to Reproduce

`sudo ./run_tests.sh -n ardut -u -c generic_config_updater/test_bgp_prefix.py -x -e '--pdb'`

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Test should wait for the patch to take effect and then query the bgp running config

resolution.title: Add `wait_until` to `bgp_prefix_tc1_remove`
resolution.description:
`bgp_prefix_tc1_remove` can fail because it asserts the gcu patch takes effect immediately but it can take a few seconds for it to take effect.
Convert the assert to a wait_until to fix this.
Details in: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/22239

The same solution was done for `bgp_prefix_tc1_replace` in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/19521

Summary:
Fixes #22239
